description: Hey ! We are two students in computer science and  this is our first hackathon . We are chill and ideally looking for people in earth science , arts and graphics/design fields
summary: We did a sonification of a big fire in France. We used data from the FIRMS API to create variations in the song. The goal was to make awareness about fires more playful and educational by sharing emotions through sound.
details:
Our project is a sonification of a fire in France. However, we strongly believe that our code could easily be reused for many different kinds of Earth observation data with only a few additions. Our goal was to raise awareness of wildfires in a more playful and educational way, by conveying emotions through sound.

We chose Python because everyone in the group knew it and it is practical. We used uv to manage the environment, and the libraries we used are matplotlib, numpy, owslib, pandas, requests, pygame and sounddevice.

We wrote our formula for sonification by using the beat phenomenon
